def: a collar (as spread around the neck)

occurrences.text: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
